title: Pasting representative and model comparisons
statement: Let C0,C1,C2,D0,D1,D2 be categories, with functors F:C0→C1,G:C1→C2,H:C0→C2,S:D0→D1,T:D1→D2,U:D0→D2, and Ri:Di→Ci. Let bF:R0⋙F→S⋙R1, bG:R1⋙G→T⋙R2, bH:R0⋙H→U⋙R2, k:H→F⋙G and s:U→S⋙T be natural transformations. Choose x∈D0,y∈D1,z,w∈D2, representative arrows sf:Sx→y and th:Ty→z that are isomorphisms, and cc:Ux→w, sc:w→z. Choose model objects v0,v1,v2,v3 and isomorphisms r0:R0x≅v0,r1:R1y≅v1,r2:R2z≅v2,rc:R2w≅v3, plus mF:Fv0→v1,mG:Gv1→v2,mH:Hv0→v3,ms:v3→v2. Assume s_x≫T(sf)≫th=cc≫sc, R2(sc)≫r2=rc≫ms, F(r0)≫mF=bF_x≫R1(sf)≫r1, G(r1)≫mG=bG_y≫R2(th)≫r2, H(r0)≫mH=bH_x≫R2(cc)≫rc, and k_v0≫G(mF)≫mG=mH≫ms, where model isomorphisms denote their homs. Then k_(R0x)≫G(bF_x)≫bG_(Sx)=bH_x≫R2(s_x).

proof.text: Postcompose both sides with the isomorphism R2(T(sf))≫R2(th)≫r2. Naturality of bG at sf moves R2(T(sf)) past bG. Substitute the second model equation, combine the maps under G, and substitute the first model equation. Naturality of k at r0 moves H(r0) to the front; then the strict model composition equation changes the remaining factors to mH≫ms. Substitute the composite model equation, use the final model naturality equation backwards, and combine the two R2 maps. The representative composition equation rewrites cc≫sc to s_x≫T(sf)≫th. This is exactly the postcomposed other side. Cancel the postcomposing isomorphism.

theorem podCompositionModelPasting
    {C₀ C₁ C₂ D₀ D₁ D₂ : Type*}
    [Category C₀] [Category C₁] [Category C₂]
    [Category D₀] [Category D₁] [Category D₂]
    {F : C₀ ⥤ C₁} {G : C₁ ⥤ C₂} {H : C₀ ⥤ C₂}
    {S : D₀ ⥤ D₁} {T : D₁ ⥤ D₂} {U : D₀ ⥤ D₂}
    {R₀ : D₀ ⥤ C₀} {R₁ : D₁ ⥤ C₁} {R₂ : D₂ ⥤ C₂}
    (bF : R₀ ⋙ F ⟶ S ⋙ R₁) (bG : R₁ ⋙ G ⟶ T ⋙ R₂)
    (bH : R₀ ⋙ H ⟶ U ⋙ R₂) (k : H ⟶ F ⋙ G) (s : U ⟶ S ⋙ T)
    (x : D₀) (y : D₁) (z w : D₂)
    (sf : S.obj x ⟶ y) (th : T.obj y ⟶ z) (cc : U.obj x ⟶ w)
    (sc : w ⟶ z) [IsIso sf] [IsIso th]
    (v₀ : C₀) (v₁ : C₁) (v₂ v₃ : C₂)
    (r₀ : R₀.obj x ≅ v₀) (r₁ : R₁.obj y ≅ v₁)
    (r₂ : R₂.obj z ≅ v₂) (rc : R₂.obj w ≅ v₃)
    (mF : F.obj v₀ ⟶ v₁) (mG : G.obj v₁ ⟶ v₂)
    (mH : H.obj v₀ ⟶ v₃) (ms : v₃ ⟶ v₂)
    (hs : s.app x ≫ T.map sf ≫ th = cc ≫ sc)
    (hr : R₂.map sc ≫ r₂.hom = rc.hom ≫ ms)
    (hf : F.map r₀.hom ≫ mF = bF.app x ≫ R₁.map sf ≫ r₁.hom)
    (hg : G.map r₁.hom ≫ mG = bG.app y ≫ R₂.map th ≫ r₂.hom)
    (hc : H.map r₀.hom ≫ mH = bH.app x ≫ R₂.map cc ≫ rc.hom)
    (hm : k.app v₀ ≫ G.map mF ≫ mG = mH ≫ ms) :
    k.app (R₀.obj x) ≫ G.map (bF.app x) ≫ bG.app (S.obj x) =
      bH.app x ≫ R₂.map (s.app x)
